d:
Bihar vidhanasbha chunav men endie ko bari barhat mili hai, bijepi aur jediyu donon ka pradarshan shandar raha hai, vahin dusri taraph mahagathbandhan ka pradarshan nirashajnak raha hai. bihar chunav ke in natijon par rajnitik vishleshak yogendr yadav ka kya kahna hai, unse khas batchit ki bibisi nyuz hindi ke editar nitin shrivastav ne.
Shut devashish
